title: New search sort options must be added to unified.ts's sort value map
answers: how do I add a new sort option to search
adding a sort field to the search UI
sort option doesn't work after adding it to the dropdown
body:
Any sort value the search UI can produce (current option or a legacy stored/URL value) must have an entry in `uiSortValues` in public/app/features/search/service/unified.ts, mapping it to the real index field name (with a leading `-` for descending).
Enforced at: public/app/features/search/service/unified.ts:toSortParam.
If skipped: the value is passed straight through to the search API as the `sort` query param; since no index field matches it, results come back unsorted with the direction silently dropped, and no error is surfaced.
